TI.P: appointing and replacing members of the Governing Board of the European Centre for the Development of Vocational Training

PREAMBLE.PREAMBLE.INIT: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,

GR.VISA.VISA:
Having regard to Council Regulation (EEC) No 337/75 of 10 February 1975 establishing the European Centre for the Development of Vocational Training, and in particular Article 4 thereof
OJ L 39, 13.2.1975, p. 1.,
Having regard to the nomination submitted to the Council by the Commission in the category of employees' representatives,

NP.TXT:
By its Decision of 16 July 2012
OJ C 228, 31.7.2012, p. 3., the Council appointed the members of the Governing Board of the European Centre for the Development of Vocational Training for the period from 18 September 2012 to 17 September 2015.
A member's seat is available for Spain on the Governing Board of the Centre in the category of employees' representatives,

ALINEA.P: The following person is hereby appointed as a member of the Governing Board of the European Centre for the Development of Vocational Training for the remainder of the term of office, which runs until 17 September 2015:
